fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole car, a 2012 Volkswagen Passat sedan.
findings: Headlight lenses look slightly hazy and yellowed, most visible on the driver-side headlight in the front three-quarter shots
Silver paint looks clean but a bit flat, with limited gloss on the hood and rear quarter panels
Light dust and road film along the lower doors and rocker area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Passat and it looks well kept. The headlight lenses look a little hazy in the photos, and a wash and wax would bring more shine out of the silver paint. We do pre-sale details and headlight restoration and come to you. Would you like a quote?
